verdict.rationale: Tags can be applied through the API, imports and the CLI ('manage tags and fields'), and subscribers can be bulk created or updated. Membership can be read back via GET /fetch/search, which filters by tags or a segment. However, nothing shows segments being created or updated programmatically; segments appear to be saved filters built in the segment builder. missing for 10: documented API to create/update segments, explicit tag create/remove endpoints and payloads, confirmation that search returns complete paginated membership, independent hands-on corroboration.
